grammar.title: 观点
lines: That all great art has this power of suggesting a world beyond is undeniable. （强调句尾的 undeniable） It is undeniable that all great art has this power of suggesting a world beyond . There is no denying that all great art has its power of suggesting a world beyond . That... is undeniable. 主语从句作主语（ 圆周句/掉尾句 ） In some moods, nature shares it. mood n.情绪/心境 share v.有同样的感情（或想法、经历等） There is no sky in June so blue that it does not point forward to a bluer , so ... that... 结果状语从句 (There is) no sunset so beautiful that i t does not waken the vision of a greater beauty , 与上形成排比 a vision which passes before it is fully glimpsed , and in passing leaves an indefinable longing and regret . 句型仿写 没有…会…（排比句型） parallelism 排比（增强气势）写作文法 long v.渴望/热望 中文里表达可望不可及的“美” 无题 李商隐 凤尾香罗薄几重，碧文圆顶夜深缝。 扇裁月魄羞难掩，车走雷声语未通。 曾是寂寥金烬暗，断无消息石榴红。 斑骓只系垂杨岸，何处西南任好风？ But, if this world is not merely a bad joke, (if) life (is not merely) a vulgar flare amid the cool radiance of the stars, and (if) existence (is not merely) an empty laugh braying across the mysteries; if these intimations of a something behind and beyond are not evil humour born of indigestion, or whimsies sent by the devil to mock and madden us, if , in a word, beauty means something, yet we must not seek to interpret the meaning. Nihilism 上世纪30年代的哲学观念：虚无主义（否定生命的意义和价值） 排比、并列句的省略 省略重复的谓语动词（Life (is not merely) a vulgar flare... and existence (is not merely) an empty laugh...） It is said that in England death is pressing, in Canada (death is) inevitable and in California (death is) optional. Small wonder. Americans’ life expectancy has nearly doubled over the past century. Failing hips can be replaced, clinical depression (can be) controlled, cataracts (can be) removed in a 30-minutes surgical procedure. blaze / flame / flare / glow 火

yearn for … / to do … 渴望…/渴望做… He yearned for her love, but she didn't feel the same. 他渴望得到她的爱，但她并无同感。 She yearned to have a baby and start a family of her own. 她渴望有个孩子，建立属于自己的家庭。
yearning n. 渴望 He felt a deep yearning to return to his native land. 他心中有一种回归故土的深切渴望。
hunger / thirst for … 渴望/渴求… I hunger for your touch and long for your presence. 我渴望你的抚摸，期待你的到来。
crave (for) sth. 渴望某事 It was the sweet life he had always craved (for). 这就是他一直渴望的甜蜜生活。
craving n. 渴望；瘾 She had a sudden craving for chocolate ice cream. 她突然非常想吃巧克力冰淇淋。

lines: amid (prep.) (fml.) among or surrounded by things 在…之中/被…包围 bray (v.) 以刺耳的高声讲话/（驴子）嘶叫 something n.重要的人/值得重视的事(注：在各大词典里未找到做名词的解释，AI 说这是极其传神的高阶用法) evil adj.坏的；邪恶的；有害的 humor n. mood 情绪 “体液”比喻性格：blood（多血质:乐观） / choler（黄胆汁质:易怒） / phlegm（粘液质:冷漠） / melancholy（黑胆汁质:忧郁的） born (out) of 因…而生/…的结果 indigestion n.本文中 指 “无法理解”（脑子无法消化） the devil 魔王，恶魔 Satan: the adversary of God and all humanity, and the leader of fallen angels mock / tease / sneer at / taunt / ridicule 嘲笑/讥讽 All truth passes through three stages. First, it is ridiculed. Second, it is violently opposed. Third, it is accepted as being self-evident. —— Arthur Schopenhauer interpret (v.) 解释/说明/口译 If we glimpse the un utter able, it is unwise to try to utter it, nor should we seek to invest with significance that which we cannot grasp . 同根词不替换 增强对比效果 nor should we... 也不应该…（nor 引出部分倒装） invest A with B 赋予A以B（某种特质、权力或感官效果） Beauty in terms of our human meanings is meaning less. in terms of ... 从某种角度/以某种方法
